title: Jharkhand HC Extends Stay on JPSC/JSSC Appointee Terminations, Appoints Retired Judge to Monitor Probe
detail: Justice Deepak Roshan's bench at the Jharkhand High Court extends its stay on the state government's cancellation of appointments made through the 11th and 13th JPSC examinations, keeping affected officials in their posts pending investigation. The court appoints retired High Court judge Gautam Kumar Choudhary to monitor the CID's Special Investigation Team probe and hear harassment complaints from candidates summoned for questioning, after counsel for petitioners alleged the SIT was pressuring innocent candidates alongside the guilty. The bench observes that while 'not all appointments were made in a fair manner,' it is 'equally true that not every appointment was tainted,' and warns that any official later proven to have benefited from fraud will still be terminated. The state's affidavit cites coaching-fraud networks operating out of Nepal, Asansol and Bihar; of 28 people arrested so far, 10 who received such coaching had passed the JSSC-CGL exam, and 265 people have been issued notices in the widening probe. Next hearing set for Oct 7, 2026.

media.caption: Jharkhand HC extends stay on JPSC/JSSC appointee terminations, names retired judge to monitor CID probe, Sep 18, 2026.
